name: Kanna (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kanna town emblem in green and navy: a green stylised mountain range above navy waves.
history: Municipal flag of Kanna, a town in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 July 2003.

features.role: Kanna town emblem — a green stylised mountain range above navy waves
